title: Vimanas and self-guiding arrows in the Vedic texts

tellings.quote: when you look at the vdic texts >> they're talking about vimmanas

plain: Greg Rogers is a doctor who has worked with NASA, the US space agency, and says he once saw a UFO in a secret hangar. On Jesse Michels' podcast he pointed to the Vedic texts, ancient sacred writings from India, and said they talk about vimanas, flying vehicles, and about arrows that guide themselves. He raises it to suggest that people thousands of years ago may have known advanced flying technology.
